context.person: A person using a renters insurance account
context.user_goal: Compare terms and change or cancel before the deadline.

product_state.preceding_state: A policy renewal offer changes the water-damage deductible while keeping the premium nearly the same.
product_state.current_state: The current deductible is $500. The renewal deductible is $1,000.
known_facts: The renewal premium is $18.20 per month.
The policy renews October 1 unless changed or canceled by September 30.

current_content.subject: An update for you
current_content.heading: An update
current_content.body: Some details have changed. Review your account.

challenge: Rewrite the transactional email so the person can understand insurance renewal deductible change, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Review and accept or modify the renewal offer.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: No action renews the policy with a higher water-damage deductible.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Compare terms and change or cancel before the deadline.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
